_doc: Voice script for tools/voice.py (F5-TTS MLX). Each speaker has one fixed reference clip in assets/audio/voices/<speaker>/ (built from a macOS say voice, pitch-shifted and coloured). 'say' overrides the spoken text when a name needs a spelling hint; 'text' is the caption.

elias.desc: Low, tired, quiet male. Narrator of the voice-over.
elias.ref_text: I did not come back for revenge. I came back because nobody else was going to finish it.

marchetti.desc: Big, coarse, older male. Fishmonger boss, loud.
marchetti.ref_text: Every fish on this pier has a price, my friend. And every man who walks in here pays it.

bell.desc: Old, warm, raspy male. The watchmaker.
bell.ref_text: Sit down, boy. A good clock never hurries, and neither should a man who wants to live long.

hale.desc: Weary middle-aged male. Police inspector, mostly heard on the phone.
hale.ref_text: Listen to me. I have been a cop in this city for twenty years, and I am tired of burying people.

lines.speaker: elias
lines.text: Three nights since Club Noir. The rain had not stopped. Neither had the clocks.
lines.say: Three nights since Club Nwar. The rain had not stopped. Neither had the clocks.

lines.speaker: bell
lines.text: Eat, Elias. You look like a man who broke something expensive.

lines.speaker: bell
lines.text: Malaspina was a tenor. There is a whole choir. And every choir needs someone to keep time.

lines.speaker: elias
lines.text: In this city, a tuning fork is a death notice.

lines.speaker: elias
lines.text: The dog pulled me out. Nobody pulled Bell out.

lines.speaker: elias
lines.text: They said it was Bell. The ring said so. The dog said nothing.

lines.speaker: elias
lines.text: Underworld rule: break a man, inherit his debts. They had sent me the bill.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: The fork means the Choir. Start at Pier 9. And keep your head down.
lines.say: The fork means the Choir. Start at Pier Nine. And keep your head down.

lines.speaker: elias
lines.text: Pier 9. Where the city guts its fish, and its debts.
lines.say: Peer nine. Where the city guts its fish, and its debts.

lines.speaker: elias
lines.text: I brought their bell back. Let them hear it ring.

lines.speaker: marchetti
lines.text: The Sandman. I thought you were a bedtime story they tell to scare tenors.

lines.speaker: marchetti
lines.text: Business. You broke Malaspina, you carry his debt. Rules are rules.
lines.say: Business. You broke Mala-speena, you carry his debt. Rules are rules.

lines.speaker: marchetti
lines.text: With pleasure. I'll weigh you by the pound!
